charge_port.notes: electrive names the "Free2move Charge NACS-CCS1 DC Adapter" for the Wagoneer S, which implies a CCS1 inlet; InsideEVs (review) says the car has no NACS plug but does not name the port standard.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: electrive lists Wagoneer S 2024-2025 (Electrek says 2026 model years qualify); the 2026 car is the same hardware with a CCS port, so the adapter works the same. Canada implied, not confirmed. Canada: the reports say "North America"; no source confirms Canadian cars are covered.

wheels.notes: Limited 4xe 4x4: 20x8.5, P235/50TR20; the Obsidian Package adds gloss-black 20 in wheels.
